typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ACCOUNT as string,
		security_adp_nbr as string,
		FAIL_AMT as integer,
		iso_currency_cd as string,
		EffDate as timestamp,
		client_nbr as string,
		Account_8 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ACCOUNT as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		FAIL_AMT as integer,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		Account_8 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ACCOUNT,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = security_adp_nbr,
		FAIL_AMT,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD = iso_currency_cd,
		EFFDATE = EffDate,
		CLIENT_NBR = client_nbr,
		Account_8),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
